findings.summary: Free-shipping check compares cart.subtotal_cents() (cents) against FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD (50 whole dollars), so orders of 50 cents or more ship free instead of the intended $50.

judge.reason: Describes the same cents vs whole-dollar threshold mismatch causing free shipping at 50 cents.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Tests only cover an empty cart and a $120 order, so they pass despite the bug; there are no tests for a cart below or exactly at the free-shipping threshold.

judge.reason: Finding that tests fail to cover the answer-key bug is always valid_other.

findings.label: valid_other
